question: Which chapter concludes with the title of the guru worship armor and guru song?
premises: The colophon locates the text in the Śrī Dakṣiṇāmnāya tradition.
It identifies the Kaṅkālamālinī Tantra as the source work.
The section is named the third chapter, the Śrī Gurupūjana Kavaca Gurugītā.
inference: This is the third chapter, named Śrī Gurupūjana Kavaca Gurugītā, in the Kaṅkālamālinī Tantra.
plain_english: Thus, in the Śrī Dakṣiṇāmnāya, in the text of one hundred and fifty thousand verses, in the Kaṅkālamālinī Tantra, the third chapter named the Śrī Gurupūjana Kavaca Gurugītā.
